title: The Needle and the Detour
hook: The needle sits on a lie. The detour adds miles.
scene: Snow on an afternoon arterial, a closed bridge ahead, the detour painted on a board you can read from the high seat. The fuel needle has been optimistic since Renton. The Ledger drinks. A detour that looks like twenty minutes on a map is forty in snow with this motor. You can gamble the needle or you can take the short ugly top-off you passed two blocks back.
decision: The detour is long and the needle is a rumor. What do you do?

options.text: Take the detour now — turning around wastes more than the risk
options.result: You take the long snow. The needle tells the truth halfway. You become a bus on a shoulder that is not a station. The cargo clock does not care that you were optimistic.

options.text: Turn back two blocks and top off before you accept the extra miles
options.result: You eat the ugly U and the short line. The needle becomes a number. The detour is still long. You finish it. Late on the log. Rolling at the end.

options.text: Coast in neutral to make the detour on what you have
options.result: You lose the motor's brake in snow. The needle does not reward you. The next light does.

options.text: Ignore the board and try the bridge — closed signs lie since the first week
options.result: The bridge is actually closed. You add a dead end to a low tank. Now you have no detour and no fuel.

debrief: Believe the detour and doubt a hopeful needle. Fuel first, then the extra miles. A bus that stops on the shoulder spends more than a top-off.

source.teaching_target: Do not enter a long detour on a hopeful fuel gauge; top off before you accept extra miles.

image_brief.subject: analog fuel needle low against a stained gauge, no readable brand marks
image_brief.foreground: cracked plastic bezel and a strip of amber vest
image_brief.midground: the needle and an empty thermos edge, snow light on the glass
image_brief.background: defocused snow, a detour board out of focus, no readable words
image_brief.read: the needle is already a rumor and the detour is still ahead
